title: Score reached its full displayed maximum (366/366) at turn ~475, after finishing only Act I plus 3 of 8 Act II holds, which can read as 'I've done everything' even though five holds, several companion questlines (Fenmarch, Hollowbrook, Saltkerns), and most of Marrowgate's city content were still untouched. (The game's own intro text does caveat this — 'it can fill long before the tale ends' — so this is a soft confusion, not a broken promise.)
